items.prompt: True or false: It is certain that the day after Monday is Tuesday.
items.explanation: Days always follow in order, so Tuesday always comes after Monday. This will happen.

items.prompt: True or false: When you roll an ordinary 1 to 6 dice, you might get a 9.
hints: What numbers are on a dice?
items.explanation: An ordinary dice only shows numbers from 1 to 6. A 9 will not happen.
